description: Facundo Bre publishes climate-representative locations selected within WMO Region VI according to ASHRAE 169-2020. The description explains that one location close to each climate-zone centroid was selected using the classification criteria. It identifies typical meteorological years TMYx.2007-2021 or TMYx.2004-2018 supplied freely by Climate.One.Building.Org. The associated building-optimisation dataset uses this climate-selection method for EnergyPlus comparisons, establishing its concrete building-simulation role. Zenodo supplies the location deposit as one ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. A limitation is that the native description does not list the selected cities, internal formats or any accuracy assessment of centroid representativeness. TMY periods describe constructed weather inputs, not continuous new observations. The related optimisation record retains its own models and results. No weather or archive body was fetched.
